node.statement: Compressed-product assembly: combining the ambient estimates with lem-compcb-rectangular-product yields universal C_co<infinity and e_co>0 for which ||u_{T,n} dot A-A||<=C_co*e*||A|| and ||A dot u_{R,n}-A||<=C_co*e*||A||; these u_{T,n},u_{R,n} are the amplified compressed units denoted u_T,u_R in the root.
